'''Hoszh Iszhir''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Gektl]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Half of Hoszh Iszhir was covered in [[Water/Legends|waterless]] deserts, while the other half was shrouded in a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. There were rich lodes of [[Guerrerite/Legends|guerrerite]] on planet, forcing the Gektl to build planetary defenses. It wasn't until [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stafuv Rahz]] traded the shield codes to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which then subjugated Hoszh Iszhir.
